threshold_note: This model is a smaller/shallower RF than the one originally evaluated (30 trees vs 300), retrained specifically to be small enough for a pure-JS export. Its probability calibration differs from the full model, so its best-F1 operating threshold is 0.8, NOT 0.4 or 0.5. Do not reuse thresholds across model versions without rescanning.
validation_notes: Validated against August 2018 Kerala floods (Vandiperiyar station): mean predicted probability 0.82 on the 13 confirmed flood days vs 0.44 on non-flood days that month; 9/13 flood days correctly flagged at threshold 0.8. Note most Aug-2018 rows were in the training split (random stratified split, not time-based), so this is a plausibility check, not a clean holdout test.
trained_on: Real Kerala flash-flood data, 2001-2025, 5 stations (KUTTYADI, MUTHANKERA, PERUMANNU, THUMPAMON, VANDIPERIYAR)
